en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style view of a European town with a shallow river in the foreground, crossed by a simple metal truss footbridge. Along the right bank stands a row of late‑19th‑century townhouses and small apartment buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the background, on a rocky hill above the town, rises a large hilltop fortress with a long, curved main building and a tall tower crowned by a statue or figure. A few pedestrians walk along the riverside promenade. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image.
